description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-081 Radio, TV & Allied Equipment Repairer against three official-source electronics-repair comparators. DOCUMENTED cites exact stored source text; NOT_EXPLICIT does not mean absent from teaching.
method: The NYSC column was assessed only from its three governed headings. Exact governed text is retained in citations; verified display_text corrects catalogue contamination or an obvious heading typo for display. Comparator cells use only the stored modules and outcomes in the linked records.

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage is FULL only where every component in category_components is named; otherwise it is PARTIAL.
methodology.FULL: Every listed component of the competency category is explicitly named in the cited evidence.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only part of the category, or a broader/lower-level activity, is explicitly documented.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available assessed source scope.
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: This published-text comparison does not prove what is or is not taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list NYSC NOT_EXPLICIT competencies documented with FULL coverage by at least two comparator records from at least two countries. PARTIAL evidence does not count.
decisions: The three sources were linked because they explicitly cover consumer audio/video, television or display servicing; general electrical-installation records were excluded.
The NYSC repair heading does not by itself establish fault diagnosis, component-level repair, amplifier work or power-supply work.
Microcontroller and LED-display-board programming are assessed conservatively: related processor, programming and LED/display evidence is PARTIAL unless both components are explicit.
